preconditions.description: The number of gnomes is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The number of queries is between 1 and 500, inclusive.
The number of minutes is between 0 and 10^9, inclusive.
The creator's id is between 1 and N, inclusive.
The friendship matrix values are either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: The output for each query contains two lines.
postconditions.description: The first line contains the count of gnomes who will know the joke after k minutes.

postconditions.expression: The second line contains the ids of gnomes who will know the joke after k minutes, in increasing order.
postconditions.description: If no one will know the joke after K minutes, then the second line contains -1.
